summary: I1-I10 scoped PASS, provisional. Core conditional proof chain coherent; full manuscript WARN due to preexisting empirical bridges and strict notation gate. User scope forbids unrelated edits.

authorized_issues.title: Undefined survival and score shorthands
authorized_issues.before: The gradient identity used undefined S_{k,theta} and unidentified G_theta.
authorized_issues.after: Define S_theta directly from S_{P_k,z_k,r_k,theta}, and G_theta from G_{k,theta}.
authorized_issues.scope: No objective, score, or integral is changed.

authorized_issues.title: Population gradient used before definition
authorized_issues.before: The full/half lemma used g before identifying its fixed target.
authorized_issues.after: Define g:=nabla J(theta) in the lemma before the expansion.
authorized_issues.scope: The existing cancellation proof and constants are unchanged.

authorized_issues.title: Trajectory score and population gradient shared g
authorized_issues.before: A trajectory realization used g_x and then renamed it G_x.
authorized_issues.scope: No random variable or estimator is replaced.

authorized_issues.title: Two call-count representations
authorized_issues.before: The proof changed T_call to a mathsf variant.
authorized_issues.after: Use T_call consistently; identify its oracle-filtration stopping property.
authorized_issues.scope: The stopped KL argument and expected-call budget remain identical.

authorized_issues.title: Consecutive episode boundary was implicit
authorized_issues.before: Algorithm 2 returned the next episode state without an explicit date bridge.
authorized_issues.scope: No horizon, wealth recurrence, or experiment is changed.

authorized_issues.title: Environment model confused with induced law
authorized_issues.before: P was called a trajectory law while P_theta was immediately used.
authorized_issues.after: Identify P as the frozen episode model and P_theta as the policy-induced augmented trajectory law.
authorized_issues.scope: Likelihood derivatives act on the policy; no extra persistent model notation is introduced.

authorized_issues.title: Simulator regularity was only implicit
authorized_issues.before: The estimator and online proofs applied standing likelihood bounds under the frozen simulator without explicit quantification.
authorized_issues.after: Require the same bounds and parameter-independence conditions uniformly for every analyzed true and frozen-simulator model, conditional on the frozen context.
authorized_issues.scope: This is an explicit assumption-scope strengthening/clarification. It does not certify arbitrary simulators or unlimited-run bounded wealth.

authorized_issues.title: Unused B_J bound alias
authorized_issues.before: B_J was defined but the theorem used the already established B_v.

authorized_issues.title: Global table obscured the semantic chain
authorized_issues.before: Two tables mixed proof-local constants with core notation and omitted the information/context bridge.
authorized_issues.after: Replace them with one 16-row core table; retain all local estimator definitions and explicitly retain market state m_u.
authorized_issues.scope: The final check caught and repaired the temporary loss of the m_u explanation in this table. No analytic lemma below the table is edited.

authorized_issues.title: Residual aggregations had ambiguous names
authorized_issues.before: Q, its square, its average expectation, and DLR were inconsistently named.
authorized_issues.after: Use projected residual, squared projected residual, average expected squared projected residual, and dynamic local regret (DLR).
authorized_issues.scope: Only names are changed; all metric definitions and experimental numerals remain intact. E3 A/B titles now include squared.

issues.note: State-step budget does not itself establish sublinear objective variation; preexisting, outside authorized fixes.
Independent cross products do not alone establish population projected-residual unbiasedness; preexisting, out of scope.
Strict whole-artifact symbol collision gate remains unsatisfied; original I1-I10 notation defects are closed.
E5-E7 remain designs and Discussion remains placeholder; intentionally unchanged.
